scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run export:ios && swift test --scratch-path ../../.codex-artifacts/native-build/SwiftPM --disable-keychain --jobs 1 && npm --prefix relay run typecheck && npm --prefix relay run build && npm --prefix relay-worker test && npm --prefix relay-worker run typecheck && npm --prefix relay-worker run build
